   "China's AI sector has shifted focus toward compute efficiency and practical applications, contrasting with the US obsession with AGI, though Chinese AI supply chain stocks have seen a sharper sell-off than US peers.",

  "insights": [
   "Morgan Stanley has updated its US market cycle framework for the first time since 2019, introducing new components and a 10-year rolling z-score methodology to better capture post-pandemic macro shifts.",
